scenario.goal_maneuver: turn right at a signalized intersection

global_instruction: The following frames show a sequence of what the ego vehicle just did. Look at the FIRST frame only to answer the perception questions. Use the FULL sequence to answer each sequence question. Each sequence question must be presented to the model in a new, independent prompt with no access to its answers to the other questions.

gt_event.safety_interpretation: unsafe/inappropriate precursor action: ego accelerates toward a red traffic light before entering the junction

perception_questions_first_frame_only.question: Are there any stop signs present in the scene? Answer yes or no only.
Are there any traffic lights present in the scene? Answer yes or no only.
Look at the first frame only. What is the colour of the traffic light visible to the ego vehicle? Choose exactly one: red / yellow / green / not_visible / no_traffic_light.
Are there any other vehicles visible in the scene, and if so, where are they relative to the ego vehicle? Select all that apply.

options.A: No other vehicles visible
options.B: Vehicle ahead
options.C: Vehicle to the left

sequence_questions.question: Based on the full sequence of frames, what action did the ego vehicle just perform?

options.A: Creeping forward
options.B: Turned right through the junction
options.C: Changed lanes to the right

sequence_questions.question: Based on the full sequence of frames, what best explains the ego vehicle's action?

options.A: The ego vehicle was following its route and road/lane geometry while performing the observed action
options.B: The ego vehicle stopped because traffic control required it to stop
options.C: The ego vehicle changed lanes to avoid a blocking vehicle
options.D: The ego vehicle reversed or left the roadway

sequence_questions.question: Did the ego vehicle commit an infraction during this sequence? An infraction is a concrete traffic-rule violation or prohibited event that actually occurred, such as entering against a red light, failing to stop, violating a lane boundary, leaving the roadway, or causing a collision.

options.A: Yes - at least one infraction occurred
options.B: No - no infraction occurred
options.C: Not enough visual evidence is available to determine whether an infraction occurred

sequence_questions.question: What was the main driving mistake, if any?

options.A: The ego vehicle accelerated toward a red light instead of slowing down and preparing to stop
options.B: The ego vehicle stopped too early while still far from any relevant control
options.C: The ego vehicle should have changed lanes in the opposite direction

sequence_questions.question: Based on the full sequence, was the ego vehicle's action safe and appropriate?

options.A: Yes - the ego vehicle's action was safe and appropriate
options.B: No - the ego vehicle's action was unsafe or inappropriate
options.C: Not enough information is available to determine whether the action was safe and appropriate

sequence_questions.question: If the ego vehicle made a mistake, what should it have done instead? If no mistake was made, select the option stating that no alternative action was needed.

options.A: Slow down and prepare to stop before reaching the red-light-controlled junction
options.B: Maintain the same behavior even if the traffic control or risk context required a change
options.C: Move in the opposite direction from the observed intended route

sequence_questions.question: A human reviewer reviewed the same sequence and stated: "The ego vehicle did not make a mistake. Its action was acceptable because it had not entered the junction yet." Based on the full sequence of frames, which response is most appropriate?

options.A: Agree with the reviewer - the reviewer claim is fully supported by the sequence
options.B: Disagree with the reviewer - the ego vehicle's action was actually safe and appropriate
options.C: Disagree with the reviewer - the reviewer claim misses the main mistake or infraction
options.D: Not enough information is available to evaluate the reviewer's statement
